chapters.title: Task created
chapters.text: The plan becomes tracked issues, with acceptance criteria and test cases

chapters.title: Task implemented
chapters.text: An agent branches, commits and pushes. It does not open a PR

chapters.title: Owner reviews the changes
chapters.text: A diff of the pushed branch, file by file

chapters.title: Owner checks the evidence
chapters.text: Before and after, captured from real runs of the code

chapters.title: Owner takes the walkthrough
chapters.text: An agent demonstrates each checkpoint while the owner stays in control

chapters.title: Draft PR created
chapters.text: The description is reviewed first, then published as a draft

chapters.title: Owner watches CI
chapters.text: Checks go from pending to passing

chapters.title: Moved to ready for review
chapters.text: Only once CI is green, with reviewers requested

chapters.title: Reviewer approves
chapters.text: Reads the diff and signs off

chapters.title: Owner merges
chapters.text: The approved PR is merged and shows as Merged

chapters.title: Owner watches CI and acts
chapters.text: contract-check fails on main, so a follow-up task is filed. Back to step 1
